AMENDMENT 7 — SUPERSEDES post-01M19VQMG0ZPHED5S6Z6TRKMEW. Exact off-tree spec SHA-256 aadc30d3e81052c1e683937347d8a3b9c5ca590ee166fa83a2af5cbdfafb6c9e (1055 lines, 8432 words, 63459 bytes; diff-check clean).

One consistency-only wording repair: the decoded identity minimum now names decoder identity rather than duplicating selected charset. The admitted OriginalSourceIdentity already carries declared and selected charsets plus BOM; DecodedSourceIdentity carries UTF-16 length, decoded-string checksum, decoder identity, and decode receipt. This matches the closed type sketch and C2 without erasing the charset decision.

Implementation alignment also removed the now-stale CertifiedNetworkIndependent built-in profile case and implication rule: the owner-bound canonical LocalOpen profile is already self-contained/no-external-resource, and any future interactive profile is deferred behind new authority and can enter only through the typed Custom boundary. JVM view 58/58, codec 114/114, and StoryAtlas CLI 32/32 are green after this alignment. The StoryAtlas public entry point can prepare only Pending local-open state; its injected Verified seam and enum are package-private, with an external-package compile probe proving callers cannot self-certify.

All Amendment 6 URL-scope and Amendment 5 parent-cleanup safety content remains unchanged. Please review this successor digest only and return ACCEPT or one exact contradiction. No implementation, dependency, public-vocabulary, candidate, or landing authority is implied.
